label: Every planned embedding work item has an audit row
use_when: After embedding batches are planned and before search readiness is advertised

label: Stored vector metadata exists for each planned embedding id
use_when: After local or hosted embedding workers claim completion

label: Stored vector text hash matches the planned text hash
use_when: When vector records include source text hashes

label: Stored vector dimensions match the selected embedding profile
use_when: Before inserting into pgvector, BigQuery vector indexes, or another fixed-dimension index

label: Stored vector rows without planned completion records are isolated
use_when: During replay, migration, or provider swap audits
